messages:
Alex W: Heads up — webinar on 4/12 is confirmed. Want to run a small micro-influencer seed + organic push the week before. Thinking 8–12 nano/micro accounts on X and 4 LinkedIn advocates. Can we map timing + assets?

Maria G: love that. timeline idea: teaser (4 days out) -> demo clip (2 days out) -> registration push (day of). keep posts short with clear CTA + UTM. :rocket:

Jin T: budget question — are we paying all 12 or doing mix of paid + reciprocity? I can allocate $2k if we need boosted posts.

Alex W: mix pls. prioritize 3 paid X boosts for high-engagement handles, rest organic outreach. Jin — can you confirm budget split by EOD?

Samir K: I can seed our partner channels + Discord folk. Who owns follow-ups? someone needs to monitor replies + DMs for signups.

Hannah (Content): I'll prepare: 15s demo clip (square), 30s teaser (landscape), 1-sheet with 3 CTAs, and 3 caption variants (short, narrative, data-led). Need final slide with UTM templates and links.

Alex W: perfect. assets deadline Wed COB. Hannah, drop links here when ready.

Hannah (Content): putting drafts in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/WebinarAssets

Maria G: caption variants — include: 1) product benefit hook, 2) benchmark stat + invite, 3) customer quote -> CTA. Use shorteners for X.

promo-bot: Reminder: scheduled posts require 48h lead time for crossposting and approval.

Alex W: noted. quick schedule sketch (rough):
```
Mon 4/8 10:00am X teaser (organic micro-seed)
Tue 4/9 11:00am LinkedIn short post (advocates)
Wed 4/10 9:00am X demo clip (paid boost x3)
Thu 4/11 12:00pm LinkedIn reminder + asset drop
Fri 4/12 8:00am X registration push + live reminders
```

Maria G: timeline looks good. Add 1-hour pre and post monitoring blocks for Samir.

Samir K: putting myself down for monitoring windows. Who replies template? we should have 3 short follow-up messages for DMs: 1) thanks + registration link, 2) quick schedule reminder, 3) speaker highlight. I can draft.

Hannah (Content): drafted DM templates here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/xyz (edit access)

Jin T: confirmed budget: $2k allocated. proposing: $700 on top performer, $500 & $300 on two others, $500 contingency for quick boosts.

Alex W: approved. Jin please run the boosts and share receipts in #finance afterwards.

Maria G: tiny ask — can we include a 1-sentence benchmark nugget for the demo clip overlay? something like: "10–30% latency reduction in production" — but check numbers with eng.

Alex W: good catch. tagging @jin? (not the same Jin) — but we'll check with eng-ml. Maria, ping eng-ml if you haven't.

Hannah (Content): will hold the stat as placeholder X.

Samir K: also recommend a 2-post cadence on LinkedIn for advocates: initial + comment prompt 24h later to boost impressions.

Maria G: agreed. advocates list — I'm thinking: 4 partners + 2 customers + 2 internal leaders. I'll assemble and DM asks.

Alex W: final action list:
- Hannah: assets + captions + Figma links by Wed COB
- Maria: advocates list + caption selection by Thu noon
- Jin: execute boosts + budget tracking by Thu EOD
- Samir: monitoring windows + DM templates final by Thu EOD

Alex W: anything else?

Hannah (Content): will add UTM examples: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr12&utm_content={variant}

Maria G: can we also add a light A/B on CTA phrasing for the paid boosts? e.g., "Reserve your spot" vs "Save my seat" — we'll test.

Alex W: yes. do both variants across the 3 paid boosts. report which wins 24h post-push.

promo-bot: Note: channel #marketing now has the scheduled campaign slot reserved for 4/8–4/12.

Samir K: I'll post a short tracker in #marketing-campaigns with who posted when + engagement numbers after.

Alex W: thanks everyone — this is enough to spin up. If no objections, I'll lock the schedule and start outreach.
